name: Supine Pelvic Tilt
steps: Lie on your back on a mat with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor, and arms resting at your sides.
Notice the small natural arch in your lower back between your spine and the mat.
Gently contract your abdominal muscles and squeeze your glutes to tilt your pelvis backward.
Press your lower back completely flat into the floor, eliminating the space under your lumbar spine.
Hold this flattened position for 5 seconds.
Relax your muscles and allow your pelvis to tilt forward back to its natural resting curve.
coaching_cues: Think of rolling your belt buckle toward your chin as you flatten your spine.
Keep your feet flat and do not push with your legs; the movement comes from your abs and glutes.
Breathe smoothly and do not hold your breath.
